features.label: Manage the helpdesk module (assign tickets, make/remove agents)

_comment: helpdesk deliberately uses the other authz idiom from docs' per-document tuples: no new object type and no top-level `relations` key (same shape as timesheet's fragment). Every access tier this module needs already exists on the platform base model's `company_module` type (internal/authz/engine/model.json) and is referenced only, never redeclared. helpdesk.manage anchors on company_module#admin (module admin: assign, make/remove agents). helpdesk.tickets.work anchors on company_module#editor, the agent tier: a member holding it sees and works ALL tickets. It is granted per member through this module's own 'make agent' admin action (S2S grant through /internal/authz/grants, as timesheet does for approvers) or automatically on assignment. helpdesk.tickets.create has an empty accessRulePayload on purpose: it is company-membership-gated only (any active member may raise a ticket), the same no-relation-leg shape docs.create and timesheet.entries.manage-own use, because company_module has no 'member' relation. Per-ticket visibility (a reporter sees their own tickets; agents and admins see all) is NEVER an engine relation check: the service compares the caller against the ticket row's reporter/assignee columns.
